Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying human immunodeficiency virus insurance program provisions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to human immunodeficiency virus insurance coverage;and amending RCW 43.70.670.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.70.670 and 2003 c 274 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) "Human immunodeficiency virus insurance program," as used inthis section, means a program that provides health insurance coveragefor individuals with human immunodeficiency virus, as defined in RCW70.24.017(7), who are not eligible for medical assistance programs fromthe department of social and health services as defined in RCW74.09.010(8) and meet eligibility requirements established by thedepartment of health. (2) The department of health may pay for health insurance coverageon behalf of persons with human immunodeficiency virus, who meetdepartment eligibility requirements, and who are eligible for"continuation coverage" as provided by the federal consolidated omnibusbudget reconciliation act of 1985, group health insurance policies, orindividual policies. ((The number of insurance policies supported by p. 1 HB 2632this program in the Washington state health insurance pool as definedin RCW 48.41.030(18) shall not grow beyond the July 1, 2003, level.))
